data_a.situation: Harbour clock JC-6110 has a bent click after the night winding, and Calder Vossine asked for a readable draft of the works note.
known_facts: JC-6110 is the harbour turret clock.
A night winder employed by the keepership wound the clock and the click is bent.
Neris Holbeck fits pendulum and chime trains and does not silence public clocks, levy keepership fees, or issue works orders.
Calder Vossine handles keepership complaints and any stoppage of a public clock.
constraints: Do not silence a public clock or charge the keepership without workshop-manager authority.
Keep the note to Calder Vossine only.
